22026877.reason: Rounds centimetres to inches with ceiling (n+2)//3 instead of round-to-nearest (n+1)//3, so n=1 cm becomes 1 inch; correct answer '0 0', program prints '0 1'.

42101202.reason: Splits feet with n//36 before rounding and rounds only the remainder, never carrying a rounded-up 12 inches into feet: n=35 prints '0 12' instead of '1 0'.

42101236.reason: Rounds any remainder >=18 cm up to a whole foot (rounding to nearest foot rather than nearest inch): n=24 prints '1 0' instead of '0 8'.

49637309.reason: Prints a single float n//36+(n%36)/3 instead of the integer pair feet/inches and performs no inch rounding: n=42 prints '3.0' instead of '1 2'.

49637385.reason: Uses ceil((n%36)/3) (round up) instead of round-to-nearest and ignores foot carry: n=1 prints '0 1' instead of '0 0'.
